title: Nimbus (thrive clone) PageSpec
description: The machine contract for a generated page. Closed template enum (ONE template), closed section enum, closed assetRole enum, closed motion object, additionalProperties:false everywhere. Structural rules JSON Schema cannot express live in compatibility/graph.json and are enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py -- a PageSpec is valid only if it passes BOTH.

route.description: Target path. '/' is the only measured route; any other path is allowed but flagged (TEMPLATE_ROUTE_MEASURED, warn).

template.description: Closed enum: this is a single-template repo.

theme.description: Exactly one theme. No light mode exists.

motion.description: CLOSED to the real, evidence-grounded motion fields. Values beyond pattern/fallback are optional but, when present, must be values measured for that pattern (MOTION_VALUES_MATCH_PATTERN). No stagger/parallax/scroll-reveal field exists.
